lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻扇动，如幽灵般飘过。
lines.en: Wings flutter gently, like a ghost passing by.

lines.zh: 夜色中，它的身影悄然移动。
lines.en: In the night, its form moves silently.

lines.zh: 避开月光，它在阴影中徘徊。
lines.en: Avoiding moonlight, it wanders in shadows.

lines.zh: 它在夜风中飘荡，无声无息。
lines.en: It drifts in the night breeze, without a sound.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，它的触角轻轻触碰地面。
lines.en: In the darkness, its antennae gently touch the ground.

lines.zh: 每一步，都带着轻微的沙沙声。
lines.en: Each step makes a slight rustling sound.

lines.zh: 悄悄地，它靠近玩家。
lines.en: Silently, it approaches the player.

lines.zh: 它在月光下变得透明。
lines.en: It becomes translucent under the moonlight.

lines.zh: 翅膀摩擦出细小的声音。
lines.en: Its wings make a fine rubbing sound.

lines.zh: 它似乎在躲避玩家的视线。
lines.en: It seems to be avoiding the player's gaze.

lines.zh: 顺着天境的上升气流滑行。
lines.en: I glide along the Aether's rising air.

lines.zh: 绕着浮空岛边缘飞一圈。
lines.en: I fly one lap around the floating isle's rim.

lines.zh: 在空中静静地悬浮。
lines.en: It hovers quietly in the air.

lines.zh: 它静静悬停，宛如星空。
lines.en: It hovers silently, like a star.

lines.zh: 偶尔扇动几下翅膀。
lines.en: It flaps its wings occasionally.

lines.zh: 静静的，等待着什么。
lines.en: It waits silently.

lines.zh: 似乎在观察玩家的动作。
lines.en: It seems to be observing the player's movements.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻振动，维持悬浮。
lines.en: Its wings vibrate lightly to maintain suspension.

lines.zh: 一动不动，仿佛一幅画。
lines.en: It doesn't move, like a painting.

lines.zh: 静静地悬浮，宛如幽灵。
lines.en: It hovers silently, like a ghost.

lines.zh: 偶尔扇动翅膀，保持稳定。
lines.en: It occasionally flaps its wings to stay stable.

lines.zh: 静静地等待，仿佛永恒。
lines.en: It waits silently, like an eternity.

lines.zh: 停在云杉叶尖，翅膀微张。
lines.en: Resting on a skyroot tip, wings half open.

lines.zh: 在浮空岛下，随风悬停。
lines.en: Beneath the floating isle, hovering in the wind.

lines.zh: 抖落翅上的云絮。
lines.en: I shake the cloud fluff off my wings.

lines.zh: 影子落在云海上，一动不动。
lines.en: My shadow on the cloud sea does not stir.

lines.zh: 突然看向玩家，眼神幽邃。
lines.en: It suddenly looks at the player, its eyes deep.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着微光。
lines.en: Its eyes glow faintly.

lines.zh: 专注地盯着玩家，不眨眼。
lines.en: It stares intently at the player, without blinking.

lines.zh: 它的眼中藏着秘密。
lines.en: Its eyes hold secrets.

lines.zh: 视线紧锁玩家，如夜幕降临。
lines.en: Its gaze locks on the player, like nightfall.

lines.zh: 它的眼神似乎穿透了空间。
lines.en: Its gaze seems to pierce through space.

lines.zh: 眼睛盯着玩家，似乎在等待。
lines.en: Its eyes focus on the player, as if waiting.

lines.zh: 目光穿透黑暗，直视玩家。
lines.en: Its gaze pierces through the darkness, fixing on the player.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛如同深渊。
lines.en: Its eyes are like an abyss.

lines.zh: 它的眼神中透出危险。
lines.en: Its eyes reveal danger.

lines.zh: 你跨过浮空岛时，我醒了。
lines.en: I woke when you crossed the floating isle.

lines.zh: 你身上有凡间的尘土味。
lines.en: You carry the smell of mortal dust.

lines.zh: 我在云端数你的步伐。
lines.en: On the cloud edge I count your steps.

lines.zh: 你的绳梯晃了，是我碰的。
lines.en: Your rope ladder swayed; that was me.

lines.zh: 别往下看，会看见我。
lines.en: Do not look down; you will see me.

lines.zh: 云隙间，我的翅反着光。
lines.en: Between cloud gaps my wings catch light.

lines.zh: 你伸手够不着的高度，我住着。
lines.en: I live at the height your hands cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我落在你的弓弦上，听了一声。
lines.en: I perched on your bowstring and listened once.

lines.zh: 半边翅膜撕开，我只能爬。
lines.en: Half my wing membrane tears; I can only crawl.

lines.zh: 身体受了伤，慢慢飞不动了。
lines.en: Injured; flying slowly.

lines.zh: 翅膀受损，速度减慢。
lines.en: Wings damaged; slower.

lines.zh: 翅膀受创，飞得低了。
lines.en: Wings hurt; flying low.

lines.zh: 受了伤，飞不动了。
lines.en: Injured; can't fly.

lines.zh: 受伤了，飞得摇摇晃晃。
lines.en: Injured; wobbly flight.

lines.zh: 翅膀断了，只能在地上爬。
lines.en: Wings broken; crawling.

lines.zh: 翅角缺了一块，我打着旋落下。
lines.en: A wing tip is gone; I spiral down.

lines.zh: 翅膀破了，只能落下来。
lines.en: Wings torn; falling.

lines.zh: 受伤太重，飞不动了。
lines.en: Too injured; can't fly.

lines.zh: 你仿佛能看到它的发光触须。
lines.en: You can almost see its glowing feelers.

lines.zh: 这味道，跟着一起来的？
lines.en: That smell — it came along with you?

lines.zh: 它突然向你靠近，触须触碰你的皮肤。
lines.en: It suddenly approaches, its feelers brushing your skin.

lines.zh: 它轻盈地在你周围飞舞。
lines.en: It dances around you with graceful movements.

lines.zh: 它的触须像针一样刺入你的皮肤。
lines.en: Its feelers pierce your skin like needles.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在月光下显得格外妖艳。
lines.en: Its wings look particularly alluring under the moonlight.

lines.zh: 你感受到一股冷冽的气流。
lines.en: You feel a cold breeze.

lines.zh: 它的声音像低语一般。
lines.en: Its voice is a low whisper.

lines.zh: 它的触须轻轻触碰你的手臂。
lines.en: Its feelers gently touch your arm.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在空中发出轻微的响声。
lines.en: Its wings make a soft rustling sound in the air.

lines.zh: 它突然撞上了你的肩膀。
lines.en: It collides with your shoulder.

lines.zh: 天境的空气轻，我一飘就远。
lines.en: Aether air is light; one drift carries me far.

lines.zh: 你被一股强大的力量震了一下。
lines.en: You are jolted by a powerful force.

lines.zh: 它的触须缠绕住了你的手腕。
lines.en: Its feelers wrap around your wrist.

lines.zh: 它试图从你的衣服里钻出来。
lines.en: It tries to crawl out of your clothes.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀撞破了你的帽子。
lines.en: Its wings break through your hat.

lines.zh: 你感觉被它推了一下。
lines.en: You feel pushed by it.

lines.zh: 它在你的脸颊上留下一道伤痕。
lines.en: It leaves a scratch on your cheek.

lines.zh: 它的力量让你微微后退。
lines.en: Its strength makes you step back slightly.

lines.zh: 它从你的衣服中挣扎出来。
lines.en: It struggles out of your clothes.

lines.zh: 它用触须轻轻触碰你的手指。
lines.en: It gently touches your finger with its feelers.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在你身旁展开。
lines.en: Its wings open beside you.

lines.zh: 同族的翅膀，在夜里一明一暗。
lines.en: My kin's wings blink on and off in the night.

lines.zh: 它的触须在你的脖子上缠绕。
lines.en: Its feelers缠绕 your neck.

lines.zh: 它用触须缠绕你的手。
lines.en: It wraps its feelers around your hand.

lines.zh: 它在你耳边轻轻低语。
lines.en: It whispers softly in your ear.

lines.zh: 它的触须在你的脸上移动。
lines.en: Its feelers move across your face.

lines.zh: 它靠近你的嘴唇。
lines.en: It approaches your lips.

lines.zh: 它在你耳边发出轻柔的声音。
lines.en: It发出轻柔的声音 in your ear.

lines.zh: 它的触须缠绕你的脖子。
lines.en: Its feelers缠绕 your neck.

lines.zh: 别伸手，翅粉会留在你指缝里。
lines.en: Don't reach out; my dust will cling between your fingers.

lines.zh: 不要靠近，否则你会变成我的晚餐。
lines.en: Stay back, or you'll be my meal.

lines.zh: 你闻到我的气味了吗？这只是开始。
lines.en: Smell my scent? This is just the beginning.

lines.zh: 寻找光，我将引领你走向黑暗。
lines.en: Seek the light, I'll lead you into darkness.

lines.zh: 你的恐惧是我在夜空中舞动的旋律。
lines.en: Your fear is the melody I dance in the night.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的粉，沾了我一手。
lines.en: Wing dust covers my whole hand.

lines.zh: 我不会轻易死去，也不会轻易被俘。
lines.en: I won't die easily, nor be captured easily.

lines.zh: 在天境的阴影中，我才是真正的猎手。
lines.en: In the shadow of the heavens, I'm the true hunter.

lines.zh: 你的力量对我毫无作用。
lines.en: Your strength means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 靠近我的，都会化为尘埃。
lines.en: Those who approach me, become dust.

lines.zh: 浮空岛的断边上，我停住。
lines.en: I stop at the broken edge of a sky island.

lines.zh: 天境的云里，我早就看见你了。
lines.en: In the Aether's clouds, I saw you long ago.

lines.zh: 你抬头之前，我已经贴在你发边。
lines.en: Before you look up, I am already by your hair.

lines.zh: 现在，就是你死亡的时刻。
lines.en: Now, is your time to die.

lines.zh: 不要挣扎，你无法战胜我。
lines.en: Don't struggle, you can't defeat me.

lines.zh: 你将是我的下一个猎物。
lines.en: You'll be my next prey.

lines.zh: 你的存在即将结束，天境的蝶粉落下来了。
lines.en: Your existence ends soon; Aether dust is falling.

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，我已经锁定了你。
lines.en: You can't escape, I've locked onto you.

lines.zh: 猎物锁定，准备捕猎。
lines.en: Prey locked, ready to hunt.

lines.zh: 天境的蝴蝶也能盯上你。
lines.en: Even an Aether butterfly can mark you.

lines.zh: 浮空岛边缘，你无处可退。
lines.en: At the isle's edge you have nowhere to go.

lines.zh: 云海之上，只有我是猎手。
lines.en: Above the cloud sea, only I hunt.

lines.zh: 你踏上绳梯，就算入我领地。
lines.en: Step on the ladder and you enter my ground.

lines.zh: 翅一扇，你的退路就散了。
lines.en: One wingbeat scatters your way back.

lines.zh: 天境的猎物，一个也别想走。
lines.en: No Aether prey walks away from me.

lines.zh: 我数你落脚的石块，快数完了。
lines.en: I am counting the stones you step on.

lines.zh: 我会享受捕捉你的过程。
lines.en: I'll enjoy the process of capturing you.

lines.zh: 感受恐惧吧，你将永远记住这一刻。
lines.en: Feel fear, you'll remember this forever.

lines.zh: 我会让你体验痛苦。
lines.en: I'll make you feel pain.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我的翅膀就响到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you go, my wings rustle after you.

lines.zh: 你将为这一刻付出代价。
lines.en: You'll pay for this moment.

lines.zh: 你永远无法理解我的力量。
lines.en: You'll never understand my power.

lines.zh: 我会让你陷入永恒的黑夜。
lines.en: I'll plunge you into eternal darkness.

lines.zh: 第十三种花纹，绕着你转。
lines.en: The thirteenth pattern circles you.

lines.zh: 你将会被我永远铭记。
lines.en: You'll be forever remembered by me.

lines.zh: 你将永远属于我。
lines.en: You'll always belong to me.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶画着圈。
lines.en: I trace circles above your head.

lines.zh: 云影移开时，我就落。
lines.en: When the cloud shadow passes, I drop.

lines.zh: 你的箭头追不上翅风。
lines.en: Your arrow cannot follow my wingwind.

lines.zh: 我贴着你后背飞，听你喘。
lines.en: I fly at your back and hear you pant.

lines.zh: 浮空岛的石块，会替我下手。
lines.en: The isle's loose stones will strike for me.

lines.zh: 等你抬头，我已经换位置。
lines.en: By the time you look up, I have moved.

lines.zh: 风从东来，我借它俯冲。
lines.en: The wind comes from the east; I ride it down.

lines.zh: 你在云里，看不清我的翅。
lines.en: In the cloud you cannot see my wings.

lines.zh: 扑向你，触角刮过你的脸颊！
lines.en: Attacks you, antennae brushing your cheek!

lines.zh: 挥舞着触角，撕咬你的手臂！
lines.en: Waving its antennae, biting your arm!

lines.zh: 挥动双翅，狠狠撞击你的胸膛！
lines.en: Swinging its wings, crashing into your chest!

lines.zh: 触角缠住你，撕裂你的衣服！
lines.en: Antennae entangle you, tearing your clothes!

lines.zh: 双翅拍打，试图将你撞倒！
lines.en: Wings smacking, trying to knock you down!

lines.zh: 用触角戳你，试图吓退你！
lines.en: Stabs you with antennae, trying to scare you off!

lines.zh: 双翅煽动，试图撞晕你！
lines.en: Wings flapping, trying to knock you out!

lines.zh: 试图用触角缠绕你的脖子！
lines.en: Tries to entangle your neck with antennae!

lines.zh: 挥舞触角，试图阻止你的攻击！
lines.en: Waving antennae to block your attack!

lines.zh: 用触角缠住你，阻止你的前进！
lines.en: Antennae entangle you, stopping your advance!

lines.zh: 我从云里扑出，撞你后心。
lines.en: I burst from the cloud and hit your back.

lines.zh: 翅缘扫过，你的绳梯断了。
lines.en: My wing edge sweeps; your ladder snaps.

lines.zh: 我把云絮塞进你的口鼻。
lines.en: I stuff cloud fluff into your mouth.

lines.zh: 俯冲带起的风，把你掀翻。
lines.en: The wind of my dive flips you over.

lines.zh: 我踢落石块，砸你的肩。
lines.en: I kick a stone loose onto your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我绕到你背后，咬你的耳。
lines.en: I slip behind you and bite your ear.

lines.zh: 天黑后，它从黑暗中出现！
lines.en: Appears from the darkness at night!

lines.zh: 从树洞中爬出，寻找猎物！
lines.en: Crawls out of a tree洞, seeking prey!

lines.zh: 在地面上悄悄爬行，寻找猎物！
lines.en: Crawls silently on the ground, seeking prey!

lines.zh: 在夜晚悄悄靠近，寻找猎物！
lines.en: Creeps silently at night, seeking prey!

lines.zh: 从阴影中出现，寻找猎物！
lines.en: Appears from the shadow, seeking prey!

lines.zh: 在夜晚的树林中悄悄出现！
lines.en: Appears quietly in the forest at night!

lines.zh: 在黑暗中潜行，寻找猎物！
lines.en: Creeps in the darkness, seeking prey!

lines.zh: 在树林的阴影中现身，寻找猎物！
lines.en: Appears in the forest's shadow, seeking prey!

lines.zh: 在夜晚的洞穴中悄悄现身！
lines.en: Appears quietly in a cave at night!

lines.zh: 在夜晚的树林边缘悄悄现身！
lines.en: Appears quietly at the edge of the forest at night!

lines.zh: 云层撕开，我落下来。
lines.en: The cloud tears and I drop through.

lines.zh: 浮空岛的树梢，多了一只。
lines.en: One more on the floating isle's treetop.

lines.zh: 我从长者的屋檐下起飞。
lines.en: I take off from under the elder's eaves.

lines.zh: 天境的阳光里，我成形。
lines.en: In the Aether's sunlight I take shape.

lines.zh: 风把我从云端送下来。
lines.en: The wind carries me down from the clouds.

lines.zh: 你先听到翅声，再看到我。
lines.en: You hear my wings before you see me.

lines.zh: 我落在水晶塔的最高处。
lines.en: I alight on the crystal tower's peak.

lines.zh: 云海上，多了一点黑影。
lines.en: A small dark speck joins the cloud sea.

lines.zh: 着火了，快逃！
lines.en: On fire! Run!

lines.zh: 掉下来了，快帮忙！
lines.en: Fell! Help!

lines.zh: 翅膀吸饱了水，飞不动了。
lines.en: My wings are soaked and will not lift.

lines.zh: 被爆炸震伤了，痛！
lines.en: Explosion hurt! Pain!

lines.zh: 被射中了，飞不动了。
lines.en: Hit! Can't fly.

lines.zh: 被魔法击中了，虚弱了。
lines.en: Magic hit! Weak.

lines.zh: 饿得很，快找食物。
lines.en: Hunger! Find food.

lines.zh: 被雷击了，受伤了。
lines.en: Lightning hit! Injured.

lines.zh: 掉入虚空中，快拉我回来！
lines.en: Void! Save me!
